correctness.rationale: Kummer carry counts at j<=a and j=a+t give a-c uniformly; exact factor comparison for the witness q=1+p^a t shows valuation a-v_p(binomial(b-1,t)), and Lucas selects t with valuation c. Pure prime powers and zero-exponent cases are separately covered. Guo et al. Lemmas 4,9 justify prime support and zero valuations. Executed 139 direct gcd cases and 4453 exhaustive finite multiplier valuation cases.

originality.rationale: The original 2003 gcd-one sequence and the 2026 full-text criterion distinguish whether the gcd is 1, but do not state the valuation of its nontrivial prime factor. The new prime-adic formula and sharp coefficient are not an implication of a binary criterion without the new carry argument; searches by equality, valuations, and aliases found no coverage. Residual risk: unlocated equivalent identities.
residual_risks: Older general binomial-gcd valuation theorems under different notation might imply the formula without being returned by searches.
The cited 2026 manuscript is a modern comparison and a source for two premises; the archived 2003 sequence is the eligible motivating primary record.
